scope: Existing reviewed contract input, retained at its compatible path. Catalog generator merges these reviews; browser evidence stays distinct from API applicability. Button and M1.1 have adapter-specific review; other selection families retain the preceding partial review.

breadcrumb.states: Native links plus one final aria-current=page label; no open/selected controller state.
breadcrumb.properties: items with label/href?/icon?, label=Breadcrumb, presentation=label and native nav attributes. Final item is current text even when href is supplied; nonfinal items navigate only with a real href.
breadcrumb.sizes: No size/variant API. label, icon-label and icon use existing NavigationContent; icon mode requires authored icons and retains hidden text.
breadcrumb.fallback: Native ordered list/navigation works without JavaScript. Separators are decorative and mirror through shared logical-direction styles. Hosts own route data and heading context. No React Breadcrumb export.

pagination.states: One current page, previous/next links or unavailable noninteractive spans; ellipsis is descriptive, not an action.
pagination.properties: Required integer page/totalPages and pageHref callback; label=Pagination, presentation=icon-label. Bounds are validated. pageHref supplies real destinations; the Block/application owns fetching and routing.
pagination.sizes: Natural link sizing; label/icon-label/icon applies to previous/next, while numbered page links retain their names. No universal variant/size.
pagination.fallback: Native navigation works without enhancement; Tab/Enter follows links, not radio/menu keyboard rules. aria-current=page identifies the active number; disabled boundaries have no href. Shared icon tooltips are supplementary. No React export.

navigation-menu.states: Native current-page links and disabled noninteractive items. This is site navigation, not an ARIA menu or application menubar.
navigation-menu.properties: Required label/items; orientation=horizontal, presentation=label. Items use NavigationItem label/href/icon?/current?/disabled?/rel?. More than one enabled current item is rejected.
navigation-menu.sizes: horizontal/vertical layout and supported label/icon-label/icon content. Natural wrapping; no dropdown/open API or common size prop.
navigation-menu.fallback: Links work without JavaScript; Tab/Enter is native. Icon-only links keep names and shared tooltip enhancement. aria-current is host-authored; disabled spans are not links. Host owns route matching; no React export.

sidebar.states: Native details open/closed and nested current-page navigation. No modal focus trap or application routing is implied.
sidebar.properties: Required label/items; presentation=label, defaultOpen=true and native aside attributes. Composes NavigationMenu and an associated summary.
sidebar.sizes: Natural responsive content; label/icon-label/icon are meaningful existing modes, not separate desktop/mobile components.
sidebar.fallback: Native disclosure and links work without JavaScript. Summary Enter/Space toggles; Escape enhancement closes and returns focus to summary. Per-details AbortControllers clean up before Astro swaps; repeated page-load is guarded. No React export.

responsive-navigation.states: Desktop native navigation and a separate mobile details disclosure; open state is browser-owned and current links are host-authored.
responsive-navigation.properties: Required label/items, presentation=label and native div attributes. No defaultOpen or controlled open prop is exposed.
responsive-navigation.sizes: Shared CSS chooses desktop/mobile compositions. Existing presentation modes remain label/icon-label/icon; widths and link targets stay natural.
responsive-navigation.fallback: Desktop links and mobile summary operate without JavaScript. Escape closes the mobile details and returns focus with enhancement; no modal focus trap. Shared disclosure cleanup prevents duplicate listeners. Host owns routes; no React export.

section-navigation.states: Authored currentId or enhanced visible-section/hash tracking uses aria-current=location, not page. Links remain native fragment navigation.
section-navigation.properties: Required unique nonempty items.id and label/icon; label=Page sections, optional currentId, presentation=label and native nav attributes. Host must render the referenced section ids.
section-navigation.sizes: label/icon-label/icon only; index numerals are decorative in label mode. No open, size or variant prop.
section-navigation.fallback: Native hash links work without JavaScript. IntersectionObserver/hashchange/resize enhancement updates location state; observers, frames and listeners dispose before Astro swaps. User text editing/scroll remains native. No React export.

accordion.states: Data Slot owns expanded/collapsed items, trigger focus, disabled state and single/multiple value selection. It is disclosure, not navigation.
accordion.properties: Root native div attributes plus multiple, defaultValue string/string[], disabled, orientation=vertical, loopFocus, hiddenUntilFound and collapsible. Refer to declared parts/runtime for option defaults; trigger/content anatomy stays source-owned.
accordion.sizes: No universal presentation/size prop. Icons and text are authored through existing parts; do not force navigation presentation modes onto Accordion.
accordion.fallback: Enhancement supplies controller interactions; choose native Collapsible for no-JavaScript disclosure. Existing keyboard behavior and expanded/content relationships stay in the Data Slot runtime. Controllers dispose before swaps and initialize once. No React export; scoped preset/AT acceptance remains partial.

collapsible.states: Native details open/closed; Enter/Space activates summary. Escape enhancement closes and restores summary focus without a modal trap.
collapsible.properties: Native details attributes excluding open, required label, defaultOpen=false, icon? and presentation=label. Slot content is authored by the host; no controlled open prop or form value is added.
collapsible.sizes: Natural layout with existing label/icon-label/icon modes. Icon mode needs an icon and a meaningful stable label; no size/variant API.
collapsible.fallback: Native disclosure works without JavaScript. Shared per-details listener ownership is idempotent and aborted before Astro swaps. Separate instances remain independent. Essential instructions should remain visible; no React export.

button.states: CSS/native default, hover, active, focus-visible and disabled. Loading belongs to existing Astro LoadingButton: stable visible action label/name, separate loadingLabel status announcement and host-owned completion/failure. No loading state prop is invented on Button.
button.properties: Astro polymorphic attributes and as, variant, size, class and authored slot. Defaults: inferred button/type=button, default variant and default size; href infers an anchor. React native button attributes, ref, className and children plus shared variant/size; no href/as API.
button.sizes: xs=24, sm=28, default/md=32, lg=36px at 16px root; icon-xs/icon-sm/icon/icon-lg are square equivalents. Shared control-height primitives feed Button height aliases. Width is independent via class/className w-full. No automatic mobile enlargement or XL.
button.fallback: Native button/form/link behavior works without enhancement. Astro client events and React onClick remain host-owned. Never substitute disabled for an anchor's navigation semantics.
button.anatomy: Native action element, optional leading icon, label, optional trailing icon. Icon-only content requires a meaningful aria-label.
button.adapters: Astro has authored server markup and client events; React supports controlled host state, native event props and refs. Both share buttonVariants. React has no LoadingButton export; host code composes disabled/aria-busy/status without a second runtime.
button.validation: Native submit/reset participation requires the explicit type and form association. Button itself owns no validity or error message. Focus-visible stays visible; native disabled blocks activation.

checkbox.states: Native checked/unchecked, required validity, disabled omission and focus-visible. Optional indeterminate initializes the DOM property after enhancement and restores it on uncancelled reset; it does not set checked or change FormData.
checkbox.properties: Input attributes except type, plus indeterminate. Use checked for the authored reset value, name/value for submission, required/disabled for native behavior and aria-invalid/aria-describedby for host-owned errors. HTML readonly has no checkbox behavior.
checkbox.sizes: One natural indicator size via --dmf-selection-size; no universal size or variant prop.
checkbox.fallback: Native checkbox works without JavaScript. Mixed initialization requires enhancement; checked still determines native submission.
checkbox.anatomy: One native input[type=checkbox], CSS checked/mixed mark and an authored associated Label. Defaults: unchecked, optional, enabled, indeterminate=false; native value defaults to on.
checkbox.adapters: Astro checked authors the initial/reset value; use the DOM checked/indeterminate properties for host updates and dispatch appropriate events. React Checkbox forwards a native input ref and supports checked/onChange or defaultChecked. React mixed state uses ref.current.indeterminate, not an invented indeterminate prop; the host restores it after reset.
checkbox.validation: Native required, disabled, FormData and reset apply. Put aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the input and associate an external error. Space and associated label activate the control; readOnly is not supported checkbox behavior.

switch.states: Checked/unchecked, disabled, readOnly, required and focus-visible. Read-only remains focusable and submittable; disabled omits the generated checkbox. Required validates the checked value.
switch.properties: Button attributes plus defaultChecked, name, value, uncheckedValue, disabled, readOnly, required and size. switch:set changes checked state; switch:change reports detail.checked. aria-invalid and error associations belong on the visible switch.
switch.sizes: default and sm retain existing track/thumb geometry, including LTR track movement within RTL text. No md alias or arbitrary size is added.
switch.fallback: Server output exposes the initial named switch state. Toggling, generated form proxies and reset need enhancement; use a native Checkbox for a no-JavaScript form.
switch.anatomy: Astro button[role=switch], switch-thumb and generated native checkbox. Defaults: unchecked, enabled, optional, readOnly=false, size=default; value defaults to native on. Label associates with the visible button.
switch.adapters: Astro defaultChecked is initial state; switch:set with detail.checked requests host updates and switch:change reports checked. React renders a label with native checkbox[role=switch], track/thumb and required children. React supports checked/onChange, defaultChecked and input refs; it deliberately omits readOnly and size. No false Astro parity.
switch.validation: Astro generated checkbox owns required/reset/FormData; visible switch owns naming, focus and error associations. React native checkbox owns these behaviors directly. Disabled omits values; Astro readOnly preserves them. Space and label toggle; track remains LTR within RTL text.

radio-group.states: Single checked value, disabled group/item, readOnly group, required, focus-visible and roving focus. Arrows and Home/End skip disabled items. Read-only preserves submission and blocks user changes.
radio-group.properties: Root div attributes plus defaultValue, name, disabled, readOnly and required. Item button attributes plus required value, disabled and indicatorClass. Name the group with aria-labelledby/aria-label and every item with a visible label. radio-group:set requests a value; radio-group:change reports detail.value.
radio-group.sizes: One natural item size via --dmf-selection-size; layout is authored with classes. No size/variant or multiple-selection API.
radio-group.fallback: Generated radios, initial selected styling, keyboard behavior, validity and reset require enhancement. Use native radio inputs for a no-JavaScript form.
radio-group.anatomy: Astro root role=radiogroup after enhancement; RadioGroupItem button[role=radio], indicator and generated native radio per item. Defaults: no value, enabled, optional, readOnly=false. Item requires a unique meaningful value and label.
radio-group.adapters: Astro defaultValue initializes; radio-group:set requests changes when enabled/writable, and radio-group:change reports detail.value. React RadioGroup is a native fieldset using a union of value/onValueChange or defaultValue. React items are native inputs with refs; disabled inherits the fieldset. React does not expose readOnly or size. Root fieldset ref differs from Astro div.
radio-group.validation: Name the group and each option. Associate errors with the group and its focusable items; required native radio proxies own validity, FormData and reset. Astro arrows/Home/End skip disabled items with roving focus. React relies on native browser radio keys; orientation only controls layout. Controlled React reset is host-owned.

select.states: Single selected value or placeholder, open/closed, highlighted item, disabled root/item, required validity and focus-visible. Arrows, Home/End and typeahead navigate; Enter selects; Escape returns focus without selecting the highlighted item.
select.properties: Root div attributes and declared Data Slot placement/mount options, defaultValue/defaultOpen, placeholder, disabled, required and name. Trigger button attributes plus size and showIcon. Item value/disabled and authored labels. No readOnly or multiple-selection prop. Native generated select owns FormData/reset/validity; associate errors with the trigger.
select.sizes: Trigger default uses --dmf-select-height; sm uses --dmf-select-height-sm. Existing names stay valid.
select.fallback: Server output retains selected text or placeholder. Opening, selection and native form proxy creation require enhancement. Use Native Select when a no-JavaScript form is required. Portals refresh preset, color mode and direction on each opening.

combobox.states: Committed value, query, highlighted option, empty search, open/closed, disabled field/option, required validity and focus-visible. Highlight does not commit; Escape/Tab/blur restore the committed label. Composition and text-editing keys remain available.
combobox.properties: Required id, label and unique nonempty items; optional defaultValue, placeholder, emptyMessage and native select attributes excluding id/size/multiple. Name/form/required/disabled belong to the native select; aria-describedby/aria-invalid reach the visible input. Dispatch native change after programmatic select changes. No readOnly, remote search, free-text or multiple-selection API.
combobox.sizes: One compact Nova input composition using --dmf-select-height as a natural minimum; no new size prop. Labels and option text can wrap.
combobox.fallback: Native select is visible and functional without JavaScript. Enhancement keeps its submitted value, transfers required validity to the visible input and resets both together. Popup stays local; host clipping ancestors remain a limitation.
